chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about the ritual bath on the day of Friday, so he said: 'It is obligatory upon every male and female, slave or free.'
ai.seo_question: Is the Friday bath obligatory for everyone in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) explicitly mandates the Friday ritual bath (Ghusl al-Jumu'ah) as a compulsory act for every Muslim, irrespective of gender or social status. This ruling underscores the spiritual purification required before congregational prayers, reflecting the Imamate's emphasis on uniform religious obligations across the community.
